With Codex we're building an AI software engineer.
One that you can pair with, delegate to, or even ask to take on future tasks proactively.
Our team is a fast-moving group within OpenAI, bringing together research, engineering, design, and product.
We iteratively build the Codex agent harness and product to get the most out of the model, and we iteratively train the model to be great at complex software engineering tasks.
The Codex team is responsible for building state-of-the-art AI systems that can write code, reason about software, and act as intelligent agents for developers and non-developers alike.

As Codex's consumer adoption accelerates, enterprise demand is growing just as quickly, and there is also increasing opportunity to expand Codex through ecosystem capabilities that unlock new workflows, integrations, and discovery.

section_about:
OpenAI's Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with global pharma and biotech, CROs, and research institutions to deploy existing expertise across the R&D value chain to help customers design and ship production-grade AI systems.
We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development, converting early deployments into repeatable system standards and evaluation practices that scale across regulated environments.

OpenAI's mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.
We believe that achieving our goal requires effective engagement with public policy stakeholders and the broader community impacted by AI.
Accordingly, our Global Affairs team builds authentic, collaborative relationships with public officials and the broader AI policymaking community to inform and support our shared work in these domains.
We ensure that insights from policymakers inform our work and - in collaboration with our colleagues and external stakeholders - seek to shape policy so that it aligns with and supports our mission.
As a U.S.
Federal Affairs Lead, you will be part of OpenAI's Global Affairs team and will help develop strategies and advance OpenAI's engagement with the U.S. federal government.
You will focus on engagement with the White House, executive branch agencies, and relevant third party groups, helping to shape policy discussions and regulatory frameworks that impact AI development and deployment.
You will support OpenAI's leadership in meetings, briefings, and other engagements and will be responsible for tracking and analyzing executive actions and federal regulatory developments.

section_about:
The Data Center Build and Delivery team develops the infrastructure that supports OpenAI's research and products.
We work with engineering, construction partners and Operations to deliver safe, reliable facilities at scale.
As our portfolio grows, consistent health, safety and environmental practices and clear performance measures help teams identify risks early and deliver sites that are ready to operate.
We are looking for an HSE and Portfolio Performance Lead to strengthen health, safety and environmental oversight and performance management across our data center construction portfolio.
You will help sites meet applicable OSHA standards and other HSE requirements, from construction through commissioning and handoff to Operations.
You will work across site teams, delivery partners and central functions to establish practical expectations, verify execution and turn portfolio data into action.
This role combines hands-on HSE expertise with a portfolio view of contractor performance, risk and operational readiness.
section_responsibilities:
- Develop a consistent portfolio HSE framework covering contractor expectations, risk assessments, field verification, training and escalation, aligned with OpenAI's EHS standards and relevant specialists.
- Translate applicable OSHA construction and general-industry requirements into practical site expectations, verify implementation and clarify responsibilities as work transitions from construction to commissioning and Operations.
- Partner with site and discipline leaders to assess high-risk work, verify critical controls and escalate unsafe conditions, including electrical energization, hazardous energy, lifting, excavation and concurrent construction and operating activities.
- Establish portfolio performance measures and reporting for HSE outcomes, contractor performance, corrective-action closure and handoff readiness; align definitions with delivery and Operations teams and validate data quality.
- Lead cross-site performance reviews to identify recurring risks, compare execution against agreed expectations and drive improvement plans with accountable owners, milestones and follow-through.
- Plan risk-based site assurance and contractor reviews, support incident and near-miss investigations, verify corrective actions and embed lessons learned across the portfolio.
- Coordinate environmental compliance with site teams and specialists, including waste management, spill prevention, stormwater controls and relevant permit obligations.
- Define HSE readiness criteria for operational handoff with commissioning and Operations teams, including training, procedures, emergency preparedness, outstanding risks and transfer of required records.
- Provide clear portfolio updates and recommendations to leadership, surface decisions and resource needs early, and build consistent safety leadership across employees, developers, contractors and service providers.
section_requirements:
- Substantial experience leading HSE programs for major construction or complex industrial projects, including oversight across multiple sites or workstreams and responsibility for contractor performance.
- Working knowledge of applicable OSHA construction and general-industry standards, with experience translating requirements into site controls and verifying implementation across construction, commissioning and operating interfaces.
- Practical understanding of data center or complex industrial hazards, including electrical safety, hazardous-energy control and high-risk construction activities.
- Demonstrated ability to build assurance, performance reporting and corrective-action programs and use leading and lagging indicators to improve outcomes.
- Experience coordinating contractors, site leaders and functional specialists through commissioning and operational handoff, with clear accountability across organizational boundaries.
- Strong communication and judgment, with the ability to explain technical risk, influence leaders and field teams, and prioritize action in fast-changing environments.
section_preferred:
- Experience with owner-side HSE oversight across a data center or mission-critical infrastructure portfolio, including developer-led and self-build delivery models.
- Experience integrating environmental compliance, emergency preparedness and HSE management systems into construction and operational readiness programs.
- Relevant professional credentials, such as CSP, CIH or an equivalent safety or environmental qualification, or comparable practical expertise.

section_about:
OpenAI Consumer Devices is building the next generation of products that bring powerful AI into people's everyday lives.

- Take ownership of complete solutions and follow problems across framework, service, and underlying stack boundaries.

section_about:
OpenAI didn't begin as a traditional company.

As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world.
This company works at the frontier of intelligence.
Like any frontier, it's unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored.
Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told, in a way that feels grounded and human.
We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn't fit neatly into any of those categories yet.
This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning.

section_about:
OpenAI's Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads.
Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models.
By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI's supercomputing platform.
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced ASIC Package Signal Integrity / Power Integrity Engineer to drive electrical architecture, modeling, optimization, and validation for the most advanced AI/HPC silicon and package design.
This role focuses on high-speed SerDes and memory channel architecture, advanced 2.5D/3D package SI/PI, substrate to package co-design, power-delivery-network optimization, electromagnetic modeling, and simulation-to-measurement correlation.
The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with high-speed channel and PDN analysis across ASIC packages, interposers, substrates, and power-delivery structures, and can translate simulation results into practical design requirements for interposers and package substrate design optimization.
The engineer will work closely with ASIC, package, system, mechanical, thermal, power, and silicon validation teams from early architecture and feasibility studies through production bring-up.
section_responsibilities:
- Own SI/PI architecture and analysis for advanced AI ASIC packages from early feasibility studies through production.
- Develop and optimize high-speed electrical channels for 200G/400G SerDes, PCIe, HBM, DDR, and chiplet/die-to-die interfaces.
- Perform package, interposer and substrate modeling using 2D/3D electromagnetic solvers.
- Define and optimize package stack-ups, transmission-line structures, via transitions, breakout structures, return paths, ground shielding, bump maps, and ball maps based on SI/PI requirements.
- Develop channel loss, crosstalk, impedance, skew, return-loss, and link-budget requirements, and translate them into actionable package layout guidelines.
- Perform package-level PDN analysis, including impedance, loop inductance, DCIR, EM, dynamic voltage droop, current distribution, decoupling optimization, and power/ground architecture.
- Drive die/package co-design, including bump/BGA assignment, stack-up optimization, power/ground allocation, high-speed I/O placement, and package routing architecture.
- Develop simulation methodologies and automation flows for early architecture exploration, design-space optimization, and repeatable SI/PI sign-off.
section_requirements:
- 5+ years of experience in signal integrity, power integrity, high-speed interconnect design, PDN design and package electrical design.
- Strong understanding of signal-integrity and power-integrity fundamentals, including transmission-line behavior, impedance, loss, crosstalk, return paths, power-distribution networks, inductance, decoupling, voltage droop, and current distribution.
- Hands-on experience with electromagnetic and SI/PI simulation tools such as Synopsys HSPICE, Ansys EDT, HFSS-PI, SIwave, Cadence Clarity, Sigrity PowerSI/PowerDC, or equivalent.
- Experience with package layout environments such as Cadence APD/SIP, including the ability to review and modify package structures for SI/PI optimization.
- Experience developing automated design optimization flows for model extraction, simulation setup, post-processing, design-space exploration, or layout optimization.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across ASIC, package, PCB, system, mechanical, thermal, power, validation, and manufacturing teams.
section_preferred:
- Hands-on experience with advanced 2.5D/3D packaging, silicon or organic interposers, bridge technologies, HBM integration, IVR integration, or large-body AI/HPC packages.
- Experience developing early-stage SI/PI feasibility methodologies that support chip and package architecture decisions.
- Experience with memory architecture and high-speed memory interfaces, including HBM and DDR/LPDDR.
- Experience with high-speed laboratory validation using VNA, spectrum analyzers, TDR/TDT, high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, and probe-based measurements.
- Knowledge of package and PCB material properties, including dielectric constant, loss tangent, copper roughness, and manufacturing variation.
To comply with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidates for this role may need to meet certain legal status requirements as provided in those laws and regulations.

job_title: People Research Data Scientist, AI Fairness & Bias
section_about:
OpenAI's People team hires, engages, and retains world-class talent to safely build and deploy AGI that benefits all of humanity.
The People Analytics team helps leaders make rigorous, evidence-based talent decisions and ensures that the systems supporting those decisions are valid, reliable, fair, and accountable.
As a People Data Scientist focused on AI fairness and bias testing, you will help establish how OpenAI evaluates AI-assisted People systems and high-impact talent processes.
You will design and conduct rigorous assessments to identify, measure, and mitigate potential bias across the lifecycle of models, agents, decision-support tools, and automated workflows.
Your work will span the entire employee life-cycle, such as hiring, performance, promotion, employee development, workforce planning, etc.
You will evaluate both technical systems and the broader human-AI decision processes in which they operate, examining not only model performance but also data quality, measurement validity, differential outcomes, human oversight, and unintended consequences.
We're looking for an experienced data scientist or applied researcher who can translate complex fairness questions into defensible evaluation strategies, scalable testing infrastructure, and clear recommendations for technical teams and senior leaders.
This role is preferred to be based in San Francisco, CA.
section_responsibilities:
- Define and lead fairness and bias-testing strategies for AI-assisted People processes, models, agents, and decision-support systems from development through deployment and ongoing monitoring.
- Design rigorous algorithmic audits and validation studies, including adverse-impact analysis, subgroup and intersectional evaluation, error-rate analysis, calibration, measurement invariance, reliability, criterion-related validity, and sensitivity testing.
- Identify the appropriate fairness criteria for each use case, evaluate tradeoffs among competing definitions of fairness, and clearly document the assumptions, limitations, and residual risks of each approach.
- Evaluate end-to-end human-AI decision systems, including model outputs, user behavior, human overrides, escalation pathways, and whether AI assistance changes the quality, consistency, or equity of decisions.
- Develop evaluation approaches for generative and agentic AI, including test-set design, counterfactual testing, behavioral evaluation, human-rating studies, robustness testing, and analysis of disparate performance across populations and contexts.
- Investigate the sources of observed disparities, including data representation, label and measurement bias, proxy variables, model design, decision thresholds, workflow design, and differential adoption or usage.
- Partner with engineering, People Operations, Legal, Privacy, Security, and People Systems teams to recommend and evaluate mitigations such as data improvements, model changes, threshold adjustments, workflow redesign, monitoring controls, and additional human oversight.
- Build scalable fairness-evaluation infrastructure, including reusable datasets, automated validation pipelines, regression tests, monitoring systems, self-service tools, and standardized reporting.
- Establish research and documentation standards for fairness test plans, dataset and model documentation, validation reports, limitations, monitoring plans, and decision records.
- Translate complex findings into concise, decision-ready narratives, helping leaders understand the significance of identified risks, the strength of the evidence, available mitigation options, and remaining uncertainty.
section_requirements:
- Deep expertise in algorithmic fairness, bias measurement, responsible AI, psychometrics, applied statistics, or the evaluation of high-impact decision systems.
- Exceptional strength in research design, measurement, experimentation, causal inference, and statistical modeling.
- Hands-on experience applying methods such as subgroup and intersectional analysis, adverse-impact testing, equalized-odds and equal-opportunity analysis, demographic-parity assessment, calibration analysis, counterfactual testing, measurement invariance, reliability analysis, and validation studies.
- Strong judgment about the limitations of fairness metrics, including the ability to determine which measures are appropriate for a particular decision context rather than applying a single universal definition of fairness.
- Experience evaluating machine-learning models, generative AI systems, agents, or human-AI workflows using quantitative and qualitative evidence.
- High proficiency in Python or R and SQL, with experience working across complex, sensitive, and imperfect datasets.
- Experience building reproducible evaluation pipelines, automated testing frameworks, analytical tools, monitoring systems, or governed research workflows.
- Ability to distinguish statistical disparities from their potential causes and to communicate findings without overstating certainty or making unsupported causal or legal conclusions.
- Ability to work effectively with technical, operational, legal, privacy, and executive stakeholders and influence consequential decisions through evidence and sound judgment.
- Deep curiosity, intellectual humility, strong attention to detail, and a commitment to developing AI systems and organizational processes that work well for people across different backgrounds and circumstances.
section_preferred:
- Experience conducting fairness assessments, algorithmic audits, model-risk reviews, adverse-impact analyses, or validation studies in employment or another high-impact domain.
- Familiarity with fairness and model-evaluation tools such as Fairlearn, AI Fairness 360, responsible-AI evaluation frameworks, explainability methods, or comparable internal tooling.
- Experience evaluating large language models, generative AI systems, safety classifiers, or agentic workflows, including behavioral testing and human evaluation.
- Experience with employment selection, talent assessment, psychometrics, organizational research, or the validation of hiring, performance, promotion, or workforce decisions.

As an Audiovisual (AV) Engineer at OpenAI you will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing and ensuring the availability, reliability, and exceptional ease-of use of our conference room audio visual and video conferencing infrastructure.
The ideal candidate will have expert-level experience in audiovisual design, programming and implementation of enterprise AV systems and moderate but demonstrable networking and general IT capabilities.
This is a hybrid role and will require 3 days a week in our San Francisco office.
section_responsibilities:
- Develop, own, and continuously improve global conference room AV and video conferencing standards, with a focus on reliability, consistency, scalability, and five 9s availability.
- Design and manage enterprise conference room standards, including room archetypes, approved hardware stacks, user experience requirements, control patterns, network requirements, and supportability expectations.
- Produce and maintain standard AV drawing packages, design templates, build documentation, and release/revision cycles for global deployment.
- Establish scalable systems and processes for managing the full AV technology lifecycle, including evaluation, standardization, deployment, support, refresh, and retirement.
- Define design requirements and technical patterns for AV monitoring, alerting, automation, and operational handoff so global room standards can be supported, measured, and improved at scale.
- Oversee AV control code, programming patterns, and network requirements to move from project-specific implementations to a first-party global standard deployed consistently across offices.
- Lead AV/VC design standards and technical review for new global office buildouts, ensuring each project aligns with OpenAI's global AV architecture and user experience goals.
- Define programming, commissioning, QA, and operational handoff requirements for conference rooms and AV spaces.
- Develop and manage integrations between AV systems and core IT services, including monitoring, alerting, asset management, ticketing, calendar systems, and support workflows.
- Partner closely with ITAV Events, ITAV Upkeep, Network Engineering, Real Estate, Design and Construction, and Security to ensure AV standards meet business, operational, and technical needs.
- Own lifecycle management for conference room AV/VC technology, including vendor roadmaps, firmware strategy, end-of-life planning, approved substitutions, and global refresh planning.
- Maintain deep knowledge of AV/VC industry trends, emerging technologies, enterprise platform changes, and best practices for deploying AV at global scale.
section_requirements:
- 8+ years experience in design, installation, and troubleshooting of enterprise AV including direct experience implementing and using Google meet, Logitech and QSYS hardware at a global scale.
- Experience with enterprise networking technologies and architectures (Multicast routing, switch configuration, QoS, IGMP).
- Advanced QSYS programming experience.
- Cloud hosting experience, especially for highly available AV services like monitoring and alerting, and distributed AV transport.
- Proven experience managing global AV office deployments of over 300 av spaces.
- Demonstrable CAD (Revit, AutoCAD, Vectorworks, Visio) drawing package production experience.
- Event space design and commissioning experience with production equipment like Vizrt, AnalogWay, Yamaha, Panasonic, QSYS, NDI, Dante Ross, ST2110, Madi, etc..
- AV Scripting experience (Lua, Appscript, Python).
Bonus points for MCP integration experience.
- Expert with video conferencing platforms (Zoom, Meet, Teams).
- Experience developing RFPs (Request for Proposal) for AV integration vendors and managing the bid/build process.
- Experience with wayfinding and conference room booking hardware and software.
- Deep understanding of AV over IP (QLAN, ST 2110, Dante, NDI) and how to deploy it safely in a corporate network environment.
- Experience with IT ticketing systems and maintaining support SLAs.

The GTM Strategy & Growth team drives the growth and evolution of our B2B business across products, customer segments, and routes to market.
We partner closely with Product, Sales, Success, Data Science, Finance, and Marketing to define and execute go-to-market strategies for new product launches, commercialization models, customer growth initiatives, and market expansion opportunities.
Our work sits at the intersection of product strategy, growth, and operations - shaping how we bring products to market, how we measure success, and how we scale adoption across customer segments.
We operate across both strategic and highly operational domains, from defining long-term growth bets and commercial strategy to building launch plans, tracking performance, and driving cross-functional execution across the business.
We're looking for a strategic, hands-on individual contributor to join our GTM Strategy & Growth team and help shape how we grow and scale our B2B business across products, customer segments, and routes to market.

You'll translate business priorities into clear growth strategies, operating plans, and cross-functional execution.

section_about:
OpenAI's Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems.
We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development.
As a Technical Deployment Lead (TDL) for Life Sciences, you will define how OpenAI delivers complex systems to customers.
You will own how they are built, shipped, and adopted.
You'll translate business outcomes into a technical plan, run day-to-day execution across FDEs, Researchers, and Customer Engineers, and partner with customer teams to ensure delivery supports their goals.
You will focus on the Life Sciences vertical, partnering with pharmaceutical companies, clinical research organizations, and other data and services providers to deploy next-generation AI capabilities across their drug discovery, development, and operations.
You will own delivery end-to-end: embedding with Life Sciences customers to map workflows and success criteria, ensuring components ship on time, and leading readiness and change management for adoption.
You'll track progress, manage dependencies, make sequencing decisions, and drive 0→1 prototypes through MVP and scale.
You will also share field insights with Product and Research to guide roadmap and priorities.
Success will be measured first and foremost by impact - deployments that deliver measurable value against customer goals, drive adoption, and become critical to their workflows.
Additional measures of success include delivery reliability (milestones hit, low reopen/churn), operating leverage (patterns reused across deployments), judgment under pressure, and product impact (field signal that shifts roadmaps/architectures).
This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role.
Success requires deep technical project management expertise, extreme ownership of outcomes, and an ability to immerse in customer workflows and partner with customer teams to solve complex engineering problems at pace.
This role is based in San Francisco.
Travel up to 50% is required.
section_responsibilities:
- Own the technical delivery plan for multiple interdependent workstreams.
Translate business objectives into a roadmap with milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
- Run day-to-day engineering execution.
Track and drive delivery across OpenAI FDE and customer teams.
Keep progress unblocked and sequenced.
Make real-time trade-offs on scope and priority to protect the critical path.
- Embed with customer teams to land production deployments and drive adoption.
Map workflows, shape tools/integrations, and translate requirements into a delivery plan.
Lead onboarding, adoption, and change management.
- Partner with Product and Research so platform components and research workstreams land in time to support deployment goals.
- Codify solution patterns and evals.
Extract reusable patterns and package field signals to improve product and models.
- Own value cases and ROI.
Set impact hypotheses, baselines, and KPIs; run pre-/post-deployment measurement and report to exec sponsors.
- Shape how we engage Life Sciences customers

section_about:
We're looking for a Competitive Intelligence Lead, a senior individual contributor reporting to the Head of Competitive Intelligence, to help operationalize and scale the company's competitive intelligence capability.
This person will own high-priority competitive analyses, executive-ready insights, and GTM enablement that help Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and leadership understand where we win, where we're vulnerable, and how the market is evolving.
This is not a traditional research role.
It is a hands-on strategy role at the intersection of Product, GTM, Research, and Leadership.
You will turn competitor movements, customer feedback, product data, and market signals into clear recommendations that influence roadmap decisions, positioning, pricing, sales execution, and executive decision-making.
section_responsibilities:
- Partner with the Head of Competitive Intelligence to translate the company's CI strategy into repeatable analyses, operating rhythms, executive materials, and GTM enablement.
- Own high-priority competitor deep dives, market landscape reviews, pricing analyses, product comparisons, Harvey Ball assessments, feature matrices, and strategic opportunity/risk assessments.
- Create executive-ready insights that inform product strategy, roadmap prioritization, GTM planning, pricing, and investment decisions.
- Develop best-in-class competitive messaging, objection handling, battlecards, and enablement content for Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partnerships.
- Monitor competitor product launches, model releases, acquisitions, partnerships, pricing changes, funding activity, customer announcements, and GTM motions.
- Synthesize fast-moving and complex market information into clear implications, recommendations, and decision-ready narratives.
- Partner closely with Product Management to identify areas of differentiation, competitive gaps, customer pain points, and emerging opportunities.
- Collaborate with Marketing to sharpen positioning, messaging, and campaign strategy based on competitive dynamics.
- Prepare executive-ready competitive briefs and contribute to board-level market and competitor analyses in partnership with the VP.
- Help build and maintain dashboards, reporting, and knowledge repositories that make competitive movements visible and actionable across the company.
- Develop frameworks that evaluate competitors across capabilities, enterprise readiness, developer experience, ecosystem, security, pricing, customer value, and strategic direction.
What We're Looking For:
- 8-12+ years of experience in competitive intelligence, product strategy, strategy consulting, corporate strategy, market intelligence, product marketing, or a similar analytical role.
- Experience operating within, scaling, or helping build a competitive intelligence function in a high-growth technology company.
- Strong understanding of enterprise software, AI platforms, SaaS, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, or adjacent technical markets.
- Exceptional analytical and structured thinking skills, with the ability to distill complex markets into clear frameworks, narratives, and recommendations.
- Experience producing executive-facing strategic analyses, presentations, and recommendations.
- Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders through clarity, evidence, and judgment.
- Ability to synthesize quantitative data, qualitative research, customer feedback, win/loss insights, product information, and market intelligence into actionable recommendations.
- Experience partnering cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Executive teams.
- Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where markets, products, and competitors evolve quickly.
- Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive complex workstreams independently as a senior individual contributor.
section_preferred:
- Experience in AI, machine learning, foundation models, developer tools, or enterprise infrastructure.
- Familiarity with benchmarking methodologies, win/loss programs, competitive positioning frameworks, and market landscape mapping.
- Experience supporting enterprise sales teams with competitive enablement, objection handling, and battlecards.
- Background in management consulting, strategic planning, product marketing, or product strategy.
- Experience building dashboards, reporting systems, or knowledge repositories for competitive intelligence.
Success in This Role:
- Become a trusted strategic partner to Product, GTM, and executive teams on competitive dynamics.
- Delivered high-impact competitive analyses that shape roadmap, positioning, pricing, and sales strategy.
- Helped establish a single source of truth for competitive insights, market intelligence, and competitor assessments.
- Created recurring dashboards, reviews, and reporting that make competitive movements visible and actionable.
- Equipped Sales and Marketing with high-quality competitive content that improves confidence, consistency, and win rates.
- Helped leadership identify emerging risks and opportunities before they become obvious.
You'll thrive in this role if you are intellectually curious, highly analytical, and able to connect disparate signals into compelling strategic narratives.
You enjoy getting deep into the details, building practical systems, influencing without authority, and helping an organization make sharper decisions through a deep understanding of the competitive landscape.

Hiring the right people - especially at the executive level - is one of the most important ways we pursue this mission.

section_about:
Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and pushing towards AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world settings.
Working across the entire model stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors.
We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the constraints of physical systems to improve people's lives.
We are seeking a lead thermal simulation engineer to help accelerate the design and development of next-generation robotic systems through modeling, simulation, and analysis.
You will work closely with mechanical, electrical, controls, and robotics engineers to evaluate designs before hardware is built, identify risks early, and guide critical architecture decisions.
This role spans structural and thermal analysis and design across robotic subsystems including actuators, mechanisms, structures, electronics, and integrated systems.
You will develop simulation workflows that improve engineering velocity, increase confidence in design decisions, and help us build more capable, reliable, and manufacturable robotic platforms.
This role will be expected to be in office 4 days per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.
section_responsibilities:
- Perform thermal simulations to assess heat generation, cooling strategies, thermal interfaces, and system-level thermal performance
- Partner with mechanical, electrical, and controls engineers to influence design decisions early in development
- Build simulation models to evaluate robotic actuators, transmissions, mechanisms, structures, soft goods, and integrated assemblies
- Correlate simulation results with physical testing and develop methodologies to improve model accuracy
- Support architecture trade studies by evaluating design concepts before hardware is built
- Develop simulation workflows, standards, and best practices that scale across the robotics organization
- Identify technical risks and recommend design changes to improve performance, reliability, and manufacturability
- Support root cause investigations by combining test data, failure analysis, and simulation results
- Contribute to long-term simulation capabilities including multiphysics modeling, digital twins, and system-level analysis

- Have strong intuition for mechanical systems and can connect simulation results to real-world hardware behavior
- Balance modeling rigor with practical engineering judgment and development speed
- Enjoy collaborating closely with hardware teams and influencing products from concept through deployment

- Experience correlating simulation models with physical test data and validation campaigns for high volume products
- Familiarity with robotic systems, actuators, mechanisms, power electronics, batteries, or other highly integrated hardware systems
- Experience developing simulation methodologies, automation tools, or organization-wide thermal workflows

job_title: Policy and Partnerships Lead CEE and Baltics, Global Affairs
section_about:
OpenAI's mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity.
Achieving this requires effective engagement with policymakers and the broader communities impacted by AI.
Our Global Affairs team builds authentic, collaborative relationships with public officials and the wider AI policymaking community.
We work to ensure that insights from policymakers and external stakeholders inform OpenAI's work and, in collaboration with colleagues across the organization, support the development of thoughtful regulation, industry standards, and the safe and beneficial development of AI.
As the Policy and Partnerships Lead CEE & Baltics, you will develop and lead OpenAI's public policy and partnerships strategy across Central and Eastern Europe and the Baltics as part of our broader European team.
You will determine where OpenAI should engage most deeply, develop differentiated country strategies, and connect national political and policy dynamics with OpenAI's broader European and global objectives.
You will build trusted relationships with governments, regulators, public administrations, civil society, business, research institutions, and other influential stakeholders, while identifying practical, high-impact opportunities to demonstrate how AI can contribute to economic competitiveness, public-sector modernization, education and skills, security, resilience, and broader societal benefit.
You will also serve as an important bridge between national capitals and Brussels, surfacing regional intelligence, assessing where national debates may influence Europe-wide outcomes, and translating OpenAI's European priorities into locally credible strategies and engagement.
This is a senior, high-ownership role at the intersection of public policy, government affairs, and partnership building.
You will work closely with colleagues across Global Affairs, Legal, Communications, Product, Safety and Security, Partnerships, and Go-to-Market, and report to the Head of EU Member States Policy & Partnerships.
Warsaw is the preferred location for this role.
Exceptional candidates based elsewhere in Central and Eastern Europe or the Baltics may be considered, subject to employment feasibility.
We offer relocation assistance to new employees.
The role will involve frequent travel across the region, periodic travel elsewhere in Europe and occasional travel to the US (approximately three times per year).
section_responsibilities:
- Develop and execute OpenAI's public policy and partnerships strategy across Central and Eastern Europe and the Baltics, identifying priority markets, issues, and opportunities for engagement.
- Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior policymakers, regulators, public administrations, civil society organizations, researchers, business leaders, and other influential stakeholders.
- Develop differentiated country strategies that reflect local political, economic, and regulatory dynamics while advancing OpenAI's broader European and global priorities.
- Lead engagement on key AI and technology policy issues, helping shape policy environments that support the safe and responsible development and deployment of AI.
- Identify and develop partnerships, programs, coalitions, and initiatives that translate OpenAI's mission and policy priorities into tangible regional impact.
- Monitor political, legislative, and regulatory developments across the region, surface emerging risks and opportunities, and provide clear strategic recommendations to internal stakeholders.
- Serve as a bridge between national capitals and Brussels, helping connect national policy developments with EU-level debates, regulation, and implementation.
- Represent OpenAI in senior-level meetings, industry forums, conferences, and other public and private engagements.
- Prepare OpenAI leaders for engagement with policymakers and external stakeholders, including developing briefing materials, policy positions, and strategic recommendations.
- Work cross-functionally with Legal, Communications, Product, Safety and Security, Partnerships, Go-to-Market, and other teams to develop and execute coordinated strategies.
section_requirements:
- Have deep knowledge of the political, institutional, and technology-policy landscape across Central and Eastern Europe and/or the Baltics, with meaningful credibility in at least one priority market.
- Have an established network and experience building trusted relationships with policymakers, regulators, civil society, and other senior stakeholders.
- Understand EU policymaking and the interaction between Brussels-level policy, national politics, regulation, and implementation.
- Bring strong technology-policy judgment and an understanding of issues relevant to AI, such as privacy, data, competition, copyright, product safety, and consumer protection.
Direct AI-policy experience is a significant plus.
- Have a track record of translating political relationships and policy objectives into concrete partnerships, programs, coalitions, campaigns, or other initiatives with meaningful impact.
- Are comfortable working across multiple countries and political environments, recognizing where a common regional approach creates leverage and where local nuance is essential.
- Are highly self-directed and able to manage multiple markets and workstreams through rapid cycles of analysis, decision-making, and execution.
- Build trust with senior stakeholders while exercising the judgment to challenge assumptions, reshape an approach, or advise against opportunities that are unlikely to have meaningful impact.
- Are an effective coalition builder who can bring together internal teams and external partners around a shared strategy.
- Communicate complex technical and policy concepts clearly to diverse audiences and have the executive presence to represent OpenAI in sensitive, senior-level settings.
- Bring strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, project management, and cross-functional leadership skills.
- Care deeply about the potential for AI to benefit society while remaining thoughtful about its risks and the responsibilities associated with its development and deployment.
- Demonstrate sound judgment, intellectual agility, and outstanding personal integrity.
- Are fluent in English.
Professional proficiency in at least one CEE or Baltic language is strongly preferred, with Polish particularly valuable.

section_about:
Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence.
We develop and execute strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and usage for OpenAI's products and platform among our core audiences.
Our Consumer Product Marketing team helps people discover ChatGPT's capabilities, build everyday habits, and get more value from our products and subscriptions.
We bring together customer insight, positioning, and measurable adoption programs, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Design, Data Science, and Growth to connect what we launch with how people use it.
As a Product Marketer on OpenAI's Consumer Product Marketing team, you will help people discover what ChatGPT can do, put it to use, and keep coming back.
You will own the consumer lifecycle email program, turning product launches and customer insights into campaigns that drive activation, engagement, retention, and paid adoption.
You will set the channel strategy and roadmap, develop compelling messaging and creative, and lead campaigns from brief through launch and measurement.
Working with product marketing leads and partners across Product, Growth, Data Science, Engineering, and Creative, you will build relevant journeys for free and paid users, from their first experience with ChatGPT to discovering new capabilities and getting more from a subscription.
This is a hands-on role for a marketer who combines strong storytelling with analytical rigor and operational ownership.
You should be equally comfortable sharpening a headline, defining an audience, interpreting an experiment, and improving how campaigns get built.
Success means a repeatable program that delivers measurable user impact and useful learnings every week.
section_responsibilities:
- Own the strategy, roadmap, and standards for ChatGPT's consumer lifecycle email program across product launches, sustained adoption campaigns, and automated journeys.
- Turn product positioning, customer research, and usage insights into clear messages, compelling creative, and practical use cases that help people take action.
- Map the customer journey, identify barriers to adoption, and prioritize opportunities using audience needs, behavioral data, and expected business impact.
- Build and optimize onboarding, feature activation, setup reminders, and re-engagement programs that help free and paid users build lasting habits with ChatGPT.
- Partner with the consumer subscriptions PMM and Growth teams on trials, upgrades, and subscriber retention, translating plan value into relevant lifecycle campaigns.
- Lead campaign delivery from briefing and copywriting through creative development, localization, quality assurance, and launch, coordinating agencies and cross-functional partners.
- Define audience segments, eligibility, timing, and calls to action with Data Science and Engineering so each message reaches the right users at the right moment.
- Develop a testing roadmap across messaging, creative, targeting, and customer journeys.
Partner with Data Science on experiment design and holdouts, then turn successful tests into ongoing programs.
- Measure incremental product adoption, active usage, retention, and paid conversion alongside email engagement.
Share regular readouts with clear learnings, limitations, and recommended next steps.
- Improve campaign production and reporting through reusable templates, automation, and better tooling in partnership with Marketing Operations and Engineering.
- Partner with Growth and product teams to connect email with landing pages, in-product messaging, push notifications, and broader campaigns, sharing insights that improve the customer experience.

section_about:
Lead OpenAI's field delivery of civil works, structures, building envelope, architectural fit-out and landscape interfaces, from site preparation through completed facilities.
You will be OpenAI's accountable on-site lead for civil, structural, landscape and architectural construction, directing and overseeing the work of general contractors, specialist contractors and other service providers within your discipline.
You will combine practical subject-matter depth with hands-on field leadership, managing contracted support to deliver safe, high-quality work to the integrated construction plan.
Reporting and scope
Report to the Site Construction Manager, who reports through the applicable project-management leadership.
Coordinate design interpretation and technical decisions with the responsible civil, structural and architectural engineers.
Own day-to-day discipline execution and contractor performance within the assigned site scope and delegated authority.
Coordinate priorities and interfaces through the Site Construction Manager; escalate material cost, schedule, design and acceptance decisions to the appropriate owners.
This is a senior site delivery role, suited to an experienced superintendent, supervisor, manager or trade lead.
Accountability is for an assigned discipline and site work packages.
Site assignment, duration and any shared coverage follow project phase, workload and the staffing plan; effective on-site coverage is required during critical activities.
section_responsibilities:
- Direct and coordinate general contractors, civil and structural trades, architectural contractors and specialist service providers against the approved design, construction schedule and quality requirements.
- Oversee earthworks, grading, drainage, underground interfaces, foundations, concrete, structural steel, building envelope and architectural completion; coordinate landscape and external works.
- Review constructability, work sequencing, contractor work plans, RFIs, submittals and proposed changes; obtain design decisions from the responsible engineers and track field implementation.
- Coordinate building and underground interfaces with mechanical, electrical and network leads and hardware deployment teams, protecting access, equipment routes and installation readiness.
- Inspect work with quality teams, track nonconformances and punch lists, and verify contractor closeout, as-built records and turnover readiness.
- Set clear contractor deliverables and work priorities; review staffing, progress and quality, identify constraints early, and drive recovery actions through the Site Construction Manager.
- Provide concise progress and risk reporting, evaluate field impacts of proposed changes, and maintain accountable handoffs between construction partners and OpenAI teams.
section_requirements:
- Typically 8-10 years of civil, structural or architectural construction experience, including substantial data center or comparable complex industrial site delivery and responsibility for contractors or multiple work packages.
Equivalent depth of practical delivery experience will be considered.
- Ability to read and coordinate civil, structural and architectural drawings, specifications, surveys and relevant geotechnical information, recognizing impacts on grading, drainage, earthworks, foundations, underground services and building construction.
- Experience translating approved designs into buildable field packages, sequencing, temporary-work interfaces and inspection hold points; assess utility conflicts, equipment access and phased handover before releasing work.
- Experience reviewing RFIs, submittals and field changes, coordinating design decisions with the engineer of record, and verifying approved changes in the field while preserving clear design responsibility.
- Practical knowledge of inspection and acceptance evidence for civil works, concrete, steel, building envelope and architectural completion, including nonconformance resolution, punch lists and as-built records.
- Ability to coordinate construction with permitting conditions, environmental constraints and authorities having jurisdiction through the responsible engineering and EHS teams.
- Demonstrated ability to lead contractors and service providers through changing site conditions, set clear deliverables and acceptance criteria, and resolve performance gaps across organizations without relying on direct reporting authority.
- Strong written and verbal communication: maintain accurate field records, action and decision logs, and explain technical risks, schedule impacts and recovery options to site leadership, engineers and delivery partners.
- Sound judgment when information is incomplete: identify assumptions, prerequisites and interfaces, determine what work can proceed within approved authority, and escalate unresolved risks before they affect safety, quality or delivery.
- Relevant trade, apprenticeship, technical or degree-based preparation, or equivalent practical experience.
Demonstrated field leadership and subject-matter competence are central to this site role.

section_about:
The Graphics team builds the graphics runtimes and rendering systems that power next-generation user interfaces and visual experiences.
We work across rendering pipelines, display composition, and GPU optimization to deliver beautiful, performant, and reliable real-time graphics across devices.
Our work spans from early architecture through production, partnering closely with camera, vision, and UX teams to create seamless visual interactions.
As a Graphics engineer, you will design, implement, and optimize real-time rendering pipelines and graphics frameworks for 2D and 3D applications.
You'll own the end-to-end display and composition path-covering swapchains, frame pacing, vsync, color/HDR, and zero-copy buffer flow-while driving system reliability and performance at scale.
We're looking for engineers who combine deep technical expertise in rendering and GPU systems with a strong product sense for crafting responsive, high-quality user experiences.
We use a hybrid work model of four days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.
section_responsibilities:
- Build and evolve graphics runtimes and libraries (text/raster, image pipelines, materials/shaders, scene graph) for app/UI developers.
- Design, implement, and optimize real-time rendering pipelines (2D/3D) using Vulkan or OpenGL ES.
- Own the display and composition path, including swapchains, frame pacing, vsync, color/HDR, and zero-copy buffer flow.
- Establish performance and quality bars through GPU/CPU profiling, frame-time analysis, and optimization for memory, power, and thermal budgets.
- Collaborate with camera, vision, and UX teams to enable compositing, effects, and media/compute interoperability.
- Drive reliability through robust startup/shutdown, crash capture, graceful GPU resets, and automated graphics tests in CI.
section_requirements:
- Have deep experience shipping graphics or high-performance systems on Linux, Android, or iOS devices.
- Have built or contributed to UI/rendering frameworks.
- Are familiar with Vulkan, Metal, or OpenGL ES.
- Are proficient in C/C++ and modern shading languages.
- Understand display pipelines and windowing/compositors (e.g., DRM/KMS, Wayland, SurfaceFlinger/HWC, macOS/iOS render server, IOMobileFramebuffer).
- Have a proven track record shipping real-time rendering features with tight latency, power, and memory constraints.
- Are fluent with profiling and debugging tools (RenderDoc, Xcode Metal frame debugger, perf/ftrace/Instruments, GDB/LLDB).
- Enjoy working closely with designers to balance visual ambition and engineering constraints.
- (Nice to have) Experience with text and 2D stacks (Skia, FreeType/HarfBuzz, CoreGraphics) or vector/raster pipelines.
- (Nice to have) Familiarity with color management and HDR (ICC color profiles, wide-gamut workflows).
- (Nice to have) Experience with compute/graphics interop (Vulkan compute, CUDA/OpenCL/Metal) and image processing chains.
- (Nice to have) Exposure to graphics driver or Mesa stack development, or kernel/media paths.
- (Nice to have) Experience with robotics, AR/VR, wearables, or other real-time, resource-constrained products.

job_title: Strategic Program Manager, Office of the CRO
section_about:
OpenAI is building a global executive engagement program that helps our most important customers, partners, and prospects realize the full strategic value of AI.
We are looking for a senior, commercially minded operator to lead this work within the Office of the CRO.
This person will design and scale a high-impact executive engagement program for OpenAI's C-suite, with a focus on priority enterprise accounts, strategic partners, and defining commercial moments.
Sitting at the intersection of Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Communications, and the Office of the CRO, this role will turn account insights, customer priorities, and business opportunities into purposeful executive engagement that strengthens executive relationships and advances strategic customer outcomes.
This is also a key leadership role within the Office of the CRO.
You will serve as a trusted partner to the Chief of Staff and CRO, leading high-priority initiatives, driving cross-functional execution, and bringing clarity, pace, and operational rigor to some of the company's most important customer engagements.
section_responsibilities:
BUILD THE GLOBAL EXECUTIVE ENGAGEMENT PROGRAM
- Define the strategy, operating model, governance, and success measures for executive engagement across OpenAI's priority accounts, regions, and strategic moments.
- Develop a scalable framework for determining where executive involvement will create the greatest customer and commercial impact.
- Build repeatable playbooks for executive sponsorship, account planning, customer follow-through, advisory forums, executive events, and global market engagement.
- Maintain visibility into executive relationship coverage, commitments, risks, and opportunities across priority accounts.
- Establish the operating cadence that aligns Sales leadership, account teams, and executives around upcoming engagements, decisions, and follow-through.
- Lead the strategy and execution for marquee executive engagement moments-including Davos, Sun Valley, and other C-suite convenings-ensuring each has clear commercial objectives and measurable outcomes.
LEAD STRATEGIC EXECUTIVE ENGAGEMENTS
- Own the end-to-end strategy and execution for high-stakes executive customer and partner engagements, from qualification and preparation through meeting design and post-meeting execution.
- Translate complex account dynamics, customer priorities, competitive context, and OpenAI strategy into concise, decision-ready executive briefings.
- Partner with account teams to define engagement objectives, executive attendees, customer value propositions, and desired business outcomes.
- Coach sales leaders and account teams on executive presence, strategic storytelling, executive relationship mapping, and engagement planning.
SERVE AS A STRATEGIC LEADER IN THE OFFICE OF THE CRO
- Act as a trusted extension of the CRO, representing the Office of the CRO in cross-functional planning, operating forums, and selected customer engagements when appropriate.
- Prepare the CRO for major customer meetings, strategic decisions, market visits, and executive events.
- Synthesize complex information into clear recommendations, tradeoffs, and action plans for the CRO and Revenue Leadership Team.
- Lead high-priority cross-functional initiatives on behalf of the Office of the CRO.
- Build strong operating rhythms across the Office of the CRO, including planning cycles, executive communications, priority tracking, and accountability.
CONNECT CUSTOMER INSIGHT TO ACTION
- Surface insights from executive conversations and strategic accounts to inform Product, GTM Strategy, Customer Success, Marketing, Communications, Research, and executive leadership.
- Partner across functions to ensure executive engagements reflect OpenAI's strategic priorities and strongest customer narratives.
- Expand executive relationships across priority accounts by orchestrating the right mix of OpenAI leaders, account teams, and ecosystem partners.
- Measure program success through executive engagement, relationship health, strategic opportunity progression, customer outcomes, and commercial impact.
- Capture repeatable executive engagement best practices and customer insights that strengthen the broader GTM organization.
Within your first year, you will have built a trusted, measurable executive engagement program that:
- Focuses executive time on the customers and opportunities where it creates the greatest strategic value.
- Gives account teams a consistent, high-quality path to request, prepare for, and execute executive engagements.
- Strengthens executive relationships across OpenAI's highest-priority accounts.
- Delivers exceptional executive meetings with clear objectives, stronger customer dialogue, and disciplined follow-through.
- Establishes the Office of the CRO as a force multiplier for strategic customer engagements and cross-functional execution.
- Creates a durable feedback loop between customer executives, the Revenue organization, and OpenAI's product and company leadership.
section_requirements:
- 10+ years of experience in enterprise technology, strategic accounts, executive engagement, sales strategy, management consulting, customer success, chief of staff, or another senior commercial operating role.
- Demonstrated success partnering directly with C-suite customers and senior executives in complex, high-stakes environments.
- Strong commercial judgment and a deep understanding of how enterprise opportunities are shaped, advanced, and closed.
- Exceptional ability to synthesize complex information into clear executive narratives, recommendations, and customer-facing materials.
- Proven experience building scalable programs and operating models across Sales, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and executive leadership teams.
- Sound judgment and executive presence, with the ability to serve as a trusted proxy for senior leadership when appropriate.
- Strong coaching and influencing skills that elevate how teams prepare for and execute executive engagements.
- Experience operating across global organizations, cultures, industries, and fast-moving priorities.
- Intellectual curiosity about AI, enterprise transformation, and the evolving needs of customers adopting AI at scale.

job_title: Product Manager, Self-Serve Business Growth Lead
section_about:
The Self-Serve Business Growth team is responsible for growing OpenAI's self-serve business products, with a focus on helping teams discover, adopt, and expand their usage of products like Codex and the OpenAI API.
We work across the full customer journey, including acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, and expansion.
Our goal is to help teams building with OpenAI get to value faster and grow their usage over time through intuitive, scalable, product-led experiences.
We're looking for a senior product leader to lead self-serve business growth.
In this role, you'll define the product strategy for how businesses and teams discover, adopt, retain, and expand through our self-serve experiences.
You'll identify the highest-leverage growth opportunities, partner with product teams to turn them into roadmap priorities, and build the mechanisms that help customers move seamlessly from initial usage to broader team adoption.
This role is ideal for a strategic, data-driven PM with deep experience in product-led growth, B2B products, and cross-functional influence.
section_responsibilities:
- Define the end-to-end product strategy for self-serve business growth across acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, expansion, and monetization.
- Identify and prioritize the highest-impact product opportunities that improve team adoption, usage, retention, and expansion across self-serve business products.
- Develop growth motions that help teams building with OpenAI get to value faster and expand their usage over time.
- Partner with core product teams to shape roadmap priorities and ensure growth opportunities are embedded across the product experience.
- Own self-serve business growth goals, metrics, and executive-level narratives, including progress, insights, tradeoffs, and investment needs.
- Work closely with Sales and Go-To-Market teams to design seamless handoff, upsell, and expansion motions between self-serve and Enterprise tiers.
- Use customer insights, product analytics, experimentation, and business data to inform strategy and measure impact.
- Influence cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Sales, Marketing, and Operations.
- Help build and mentor a growing team of PMs as the self-serve growth function scales.

- Experience with team-based, workspace, collaboration, or developer-facing products.

job_title: Partner Director - AWS Alliance Partnership, APAC
section_about:
OpenAI's GTM Partnerships team builds a strategic global partner ecosystem designed to accelerate customer success, support secure AI adoption, and drive growth in support of OpenAI's mission.
We collaborate closely across Sales, Technical Success, Product, Marketing, Operations, and leadership teams to turn strategic partnerships into durable commercial outcomes.
Within that ecosystem, AWS is one of OpenAI's most strategic partners.
Our opportunity extends beyond the direct alliance relationship: we aim to enable AWS teams and the surrounding services-partner ecosystem to build, deliver, and scale OpenAI-powered solutions on AWS infrastructure.
Success requires close collaboration across AWS regional and country teams, AWS-focused SI practices, cloud architects, field sellers, delivery leaders, local OpenAI Partner Directors, and OpenAI GTM teams.
It requires strong operating discipline, scalable co-sell execution, and the ability to translate a strategic alliance into measurable customer outcomes.
We are hiring a Partner Director to shape and execute OpenAI's AWS alliance partnership across APAC.
This person will own the direct regional relationship with AWS while mobilising AWS country teams and the broader services-partner ecosystem around high-value customer opportunities.
This is a hands-on individual-contributor role operating through influence across APAC.
You will work alongside local OpenAI Partner Directors to develop country-level strategies, drive joint account planning, coordinate AWS-related opportunities, and operationally manage selected cross-market initiatives.
You will build and own the regional GTM strategy with AWS, translating the alliance into repeatable OpenAI and AWS solutions, field playbooks, governance structures, and co-sell motions that can be adopted across APAC markets.
The right candidate combines alliance leadership with a builder's mindset and the ability to move comfortably between executive engagement and detailed execution
section_responsibilities:
- Jointly shape and execute the APAC AWS alliance strategy and annual operating plan with the APAC Partnerships Lead and local Partner Directors.
- Own the regional AWS alliance relationship and coordinate with AWS country teams alongside local Partner Directors.
- Build trusted relationships with AWS alliance leaders, sales teams, technical teams, cloud architects, industry leaders, and delivery stakeholders.
- Develop joint account plans and drive co-sell execution across AWS, local Partner Directors, OpenAI Sales teams, and services partners.
- Identify, shape, and accelerate qualified AWS-related opportunities and customer engagements.
- Mobilise AWS-focused practices within systems integrators, consulting firms, and specialist services partners.
- Help partners develop repeatable OpenAI offerings, reference architectures, delivery methodologies, and GTM motions aligned with AWS infrastructure and services.
- Drive operating discipline across AWS ACE, Marketplace, partner programs, funding mechanisms, pipeline tracking, partner attribution, and deal-progression workflows.
- Build and run the AWS governance model across APAC, including pipeline reviews, operating cadences, executive business reviews, milestone tracking, and escalation management.
- Develop scalable sales plays, enablement materials, field communications, and engagement strategies that local teams and partners can reuse.
- Lead or support contracting where appropriate, coordinating with local Partner Directors and legal, finance, and leadership teams.
- Aggregate feedback from AWS stakeholders, services partners, customers, and country teams and translate it into recommendations for Product, Operations, Marketing, and GTM leadership.
- Coordinate with Marketing on AWS-related launches, campaigns, enablement activities, and events.
- Represent OpenAI with executive presence in AWS, partner, customer, and market-facing conversations.
- Travel regularly across APAC, with occasional travel to the United States.
section_requirements:
- Are a builder who enjoys creating structure and turning complex regional ecosystems into repeatable motions.
- Combine a sales mindset with a focus on customer delivery and measurable outcomes.
- Build trust quickly with partners and executives while remaining comfortable with detailed execution.
- Operate with urgency and sound judgement, focusing deeply where partnership leverage is highest.
- Enjoy technical learning and can translate cloud and AI concepts into business value.
- Are excited by AI, cloud transformation, and the opportunity to define how OpenAI scales through AWS and strategic services partners across APAC.
section_preferred:
- 8+ years of experience in partnerships, cloud alliances, ecosystem sales, business development, consulting partnerships, or related GTM roles within SaaS, cloud, AI, or platform businesses.
- Significant experience building and scaling hyperscaler-alliance motions across multiple markets.
- Strong familiarity with the AWS ecosystem, including regional and country teams, ACE, Marketplace, partner programs, funding models, and co-sell workflows.
- Experience working with global and regional systems integrators and consulting firms with substantial AWS cloud practices.
- A proven record of driving measurable partner-sourced opportunities, customer wins, and repeatable solutions through strategic partnerships.
- Experience supporting complex enterprise opportunities involving cloud modernisation, AI transformation, data platforms, or large-scale technical implementations.
- Experience leading joint account planning and complex co-sell motions involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
- Comfort engaging C-Suite, cloud leaders, practice heads, and senior business stakeholders in commercially and technically informed conversations.
- Experience building scalable partner programs, operating cadences, enablement strategies, sales plays, and field motions.
- Strong technical fluency and cloud credibility, with enough depth to engage productively with architects, delivery teams, and technical decision-makers.
- Strong commercial judgement and experience leading or supporting contracting processes.
- Experience navigating highly matrixed organisations and aligning stakeholders without formal authority.
- A demonstrated ability to operate with high ownership in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

We act as a trusted advisor and thought leader for our customers, ensuring developers and enterprises maximize value from our models and products.

OpenAI Finance ensures the organization is positioned for long-term success as we pursue our mission.
The Strategic Sourcing & Procurement function plays a critical role in enabling OpenAI to deliver impact across research, product development, technology infrastructure, and services by helping the company scale responsibly, securely, and with strong commercial discipline.
Our work sits at the intersection of innovation and execution.
We partner closely with teams across OpenAI to translate rapidly evolving business needs into scalable, compliant, and economically sound external partnerships.
As OpenAI continues to grow at pace, services sourcing is becoming increasingly strategic across the company.
Every business unit relies on external service providers in different ways - to extend capacity, access specialized expertise, support operations, and accelerate execution.
Done well, Procurement becomes a source of trust and momentum, helping OpenAI move faster with the right partners, stronger commercial outcomes, and the right level of protection.
We are seeking a leader to define and drive sourcing strategy across a broad portfolio of services categories at OpenAI.
This role will shape how OpenAI sources professional services across the company, guide key decisions on supplier strategy and commercial models, and build the capabilities needed to scale this domain over time.
This is a highly strategic leadership role with broad cross-functional scope and significant visibility.
You will partner with senior leaders across Finance, Legal, Security, People, GTM, Research, Engineering, Real Estate & Workplace, and other functions to define category strategies, guide complex commercial decisions, and build scalable ways of working that improve speed, clarity, and value.
This role requires experience building and scaling sourcing in fast-moving environments - from establishing foundational capabilities and team structure to leading complex, high-spend, high-volume portfolios.
You will lead and be accountable for a growing team responsible for managing complex, high-stakes services engagements end-to-end, while evolving the sourcing model, supplier governance, and commercial approach needed to support OpenAI's growth.
This role reports into the Vice President of Procurement.

- Partner across every business unit to shape sourcing strategies for professional services, ensuring teams can access the capabilities they need with the right balance of speed, value, and governance.

- Build visibility into pipeline, cycle times, supplier performance, commercial outcomes, and category risks so leaders can make faster, better-informed decisions and drive stronger execution across the portfolio.

You will help define and execute our operating model, partner closely across Revenue Systems, Revenue Accounting, Engineering, Product, and GTM teams, and help build the operational backbone that will support the next phase of OpenAI's scale and evolution.

section_about:
OpenAI's Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with life sciences organizations to deploy production AI systems across scientific and operational workflows.
We work at the boundary of customer deployment and core platform development, using early engagements to define repeatable system patterns, evals, and operating standards for life sciences environments.
We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to lead end-to-end deployments of our models inside life sciences organizations and research institutions, focusing on workflows across discovery, clinical development, submissions, and scientific operations.
You will work with customers who are experts in their domains, translating data, infrastructure, and workflow constraints into production systems and helping define how frontier models can be applied in regulated environments.
You will measure success through production adoption, workflow impact, and eval loops that define workflow-specific benchmarks, acceptance criteria, and launch evidence for production use.
You'll work closely with Business, Research, Platform/Product, Engineering, and Security/GRC, using deployment learnings to improve both customer systems and the product and model roadmaps supporting them.
This role is based in London.
Travel up to 30% is required.
section_responsibilities:
- Own deployments from initial scoping through production adoption, including technical decisions, sequencing, and launch readiness.
- Partner with customers and internal teams to frame problems, define scope, and translate ambiguous workflow needs into system requirements and measurable endpoints.
- Define launch criteria for regulated contexts, including validation evidence, outcome metrics, and acceptance thresholds tied to production use.
- Enforce operating standards for auditability, traceability, and inspection readiness in the systems you ship.
- Design evals that measure model and system quality against workflow-specific scientific benchmarks and acceptance criteria.
- Use evaluation results, error analysis, and deployment learning to improve model selection, system design, and product feedback.
- Distill deployment learnings into reference architectures, validation templates, benchmark harnesses, and other technical primitives that can be reused across life sciences environments.
section_requirements:
- Bring 6+ years of software, ML/AI, or deployment engineering experience with customer-facing ownership in biotech, pharma, clinical research, scientific software, or adjacent technical domains.
- Have operated as a senior engineer, tech lead, or deployment owner who is trusted to make technical decisions in ambiguous environments.
- Have owned customer GenAI deployments end-to-end from scoping through production adoption.
- Have improved deployed systems through eval design, error analysis, and evidence generation that hones acceptance criteria over time.

We are responsible for developing and executing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and usage for OpenAI's products and platform.
We take a data-driven approach to understand our customers' needs and challenges, ensuring that their voices are reflected in product development and messaging.
We then partner closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Sales, Research, Comms, and Design teams to create a cohesive customer experience across all our channels.
We're looking for a senior product marketing leader to own the strategy, narrative, and go-to-market direction for ChatGPT Work.
This role will help define how professionals, teams, and organizations put AI to work on meaningful tasks, move from questions to completed work, and adopt new ways of working across their business.
You will serve as the senior product marketing owner for ChatGPT Work, shaping the category, setting portfolio priorities, and connecting product innovation to customer understanding, adoption, and growth.
Your scope will span the Work experience across surfaces, connected tools, and AI-powered workflows, with a clear focus on the needs of professional users, Business customers, and Enterprise organizations.
This is a leadership role for someone who can set strategy, make difficult tradeoffs, and stay close enough to the work to shape the messaging, product decisions, launches, and programs that determine whether customers adopt.
